rationale: Record two editor-open performance changes that cross these families' selectors. core/canvas/src/bundled_fonts.cpp returns the existing registration when a font is registered again with byte-identical data under the same family, instead of decoding the woff2 again and appending a duplicate face. core/view/src/claude_bundle.cpp scans a materialized template for packaged asset references and font bindings with string search instead of std::regex; the accepted and rejected inputs are unchanged. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: pulp-test-group-canvas re-registering identical font bytes adds no face and keeps caches valid
pulp-test-group-design-import-tool template <script src> scanning keeps the regex's matching rules
